sourceDecision.evidenceClass: BI-051A74CE security fix. Workspace > business calendar (/workspace/calendar), contextual actions only: one compact panel beside the existing External Calendar panel, reusing its styling, --dpf-* tokens and confirmDialog (awaited outside the transition). Three plain choices (Create link / Replace link / Turn off); Replace and Turn off confirm in danger tone. The link is shown once because only its hash is stored; always-visible-url would need a reversible secret and was rejected on data_privacy. A separate settings route was rejected as a new navigation home for one control. No coworker prompt is sent. Composite 9.65 vs 6.45 / 6.17, margin 3.20, confidence high.
